items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: me and Edward was back the same age... Used to feature me at all times.

ctx.x: Edward, yeah. He didn't play, oh, he didn't play. I don't think he played six or eight months. Then he cut out of me. But he got in bed coming, and he cut out.
Well, he never did look healthy, didn't he?
